title: FlipperHero
short_description: Control your Flipper Zero over Bluetooth, with an optional AI assistant.
full_description:
FlipperHero connects your Android phone to a Flipper Zero over Bluetooth. Check the device, browse its files, use the live screen remote, and ask an optional AI assistant to help with your own hardware.

DEVICE AND FILES
Pair with your Flipper Zero and confirm its pairing code on the device. View battery, firmware and storage information. Browse the SD card and read supported files. Check for firmware updates and follow installation progress.

LIVE REMOTE
Mirror the Flipper screen and use its directional controls from your phone. Tap for a short press or hold for a long press.

OPTIONAL AI ASSISTANT
Describe what you want to do in plain language. The agent can inspect your device, read files, use supported signals and explain its results. Attach a camera photo when your chosen model supports images. Actions follow the app's approval policy, with a confirmation before loosening permissions and an audit log for tool activity.

Bring your own API key for OpenRouter, 2342.ai, Blackbit, OrcaRouter, Z.ai, Kimi, Qwen Cloud or MiniMax. AI service usage is billed separately by your provider. The app price does not include AI credits. Bluetooth device controls, files and the remote work without an AI key.

PRIVACY AND CONTROL
No FlipperHero app account or advertising. API keys are stored encrypted on your phone. AI messages, attached photos and file contents used by the agent go to the provider you select. Usage analytics are optional and off by default. Report an AI reply from inside the app, with an editable excerpt and a clear preview of what will be sent.

Available in 15 languages.

Requires Android 12 or later and a physical Flipper Zero with Bluetooth enabled. Only use devices and systems you own or have permission to operate. This independent community project is not affiliated with Flipper Devices Inc. Flipper Zero is a trademark of Flipper Devices Inc.
